Name: Pikmin's Onion (JunimoHut)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[quote][color=#ff0000][size=6]Notes![/size][/color]
[size=3]This mod is a new type of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14890]this mod[/url]﻿.
Please do not install it at the same time as the old mod.[/size][/quote]

[color=#ffff00][size=5]Add "[b]Pikumin's Onion[/b]" as a new skin for Junimo Hut.[/size][/color]
[size=2]Compatible with other mods that change Junimo Hut textures by not overwriting vanilla Junimo Hut textures.
[/size][size=2]Three additional skins have been added, each of which can be independently configured in ModConfig to set its look for each season.
It is also possible to set the appearance to change every day.[/size]

You can also set the appearance of the vanilla Junimo Hut to "Pikumin's Onion" in the ModConfig settings. (It is disabled by default.)

[color=#00ff00][size=4]Compatibility with "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]".[/size][/color]
The mod does not include files for AT, but the AT paint bucket has the ability to change to other skins by default, so you can change its look so that there is in effect an AT version as well.
